HybridRace Workouts.hypothesis: Athletes reading training guides will try the generator when the CTA promises an immediate race-specific workout.
HybridRace Workouts.action: Add a reusable CTA after the first useful section of every training guide: ‘Training for a hybrid race? Generate 3 race-paced workouts free — no credit card.’ Link to /generate with utm_source=training_guides&utm_campaign=guide_activation.
HybridRace Workouts.guardrail: Guide engagement time must not fall by more than 10%
HybridRace Workouts.stop_rule: Stop or rewrite if CTR is below 2% after 200 sessions

HybridRace Workouts.hypothesis: A concrete recommended plan will reduce choice friction after free workouts are consumed.
HybridRace Workouts.action: At the workout limit, lead with the Athlete offer: ‘Keep training: 50 race-paced workouts for $5.99 once.’ Keep Unlimited $9.99 as the secondary comparison and show ‘No subscription’ beside both CTAs.
HybridRace Workouts.stop_rule: Revert if checkout-start rate is below the existing baseline after 300 views

HybridRace Workouts.hypothesis: Hybrid gyms will share a co-branded free workout generator with members before races.
HybridRace Workouts.action: Create one co-brandable /gym-partner landing-page template with a gym-name parameter, 3 free workouts, and a 20% tracked referral code. Build a qualified list of 25 independent hybrid/CrossFit gyms with public business contact pages; do not send bulk unsolicited messages.
HybridRace Workouts.target: 5 partner conversations, 2 active partners, 1 verified purchase
HybridRace Workouts.guardrail: No scraped personal emails or automated bulk outreach
HybridRace Workouts.stop_rule: Pause if 25 qualified contacts produce no replies or activations

AIWorkoutNow.hypothesis: Visitors will start more workouts when the hero promises speed and removes signup anxiety.
AIWorkoutNow.action: Test hero copy: ‘Your workout for today—in 30 seconds.’ Supporting line: ‘Choose your goal, equipment, and time. Get 3 personalized workouts free. No signup or credit card.’ Primary CTA: ‘Generate My Free Workout.’ Scroll directly to the generator and tag source=hero.
AIWorkoutNow.target: Hero CTR >= 8%; completion >= 60% after 300 landing views
AIWorkoutNow.guardrail: Bounce rate must not increase by more than 10%
AIWorkoutNow.stop_rule: Revert if hero CTR is below baseline after 300 views

AIWorkoutNow.hypothesis: Users who receive a useful first workout are more receptive to a paid plan than cold homepage visitors.
AIWorkoutNow.action: Below the first generated workout, add: ‘Want your next week planned too?’ Show one recommended paid option, its exact one-time price, and a ‘See Plans’ CTA. Track generated_result_upgrade_click with workout type and source.
AIWorkoutNow.guardrail: Workout save/print usage must not decrease
AIWorkoutNow.stop_rule: Remove if CTR is below 2% after 200 generated workouts

AIWorkoutNow.hypothesis: Intent-matched examples and preselected generator settings will convert SEO visitors better than a generic CTA.
AIWorkoutNow.action: On the five highest-intent landing pages, add a sample workout plus ‘Customize this workout’ that opens the generator with goal, equipment, and duration preselected. Start with home, dumbbell, strength, weight-loss, and beginner pages.
AIWorkoutNow.guardrail: No indexability, canonical, or page-speed regression
AIWorkoutNow.stop_rule: Stop expanding if the first five pages produce fewer than 20 activations

LuckyNumbersLab.hypothesis: Visitors on statistics pages will use the product when the CTA continues their current analysis rather than promising prediction accuracy.
LuckyNumbersLab.action: Add a contextual CTA to Powerball, Mega Millions, hot-number, overdue-number, and best-picks pages: ‘Use this draw history in the generator.’ Preselect the current lottery and link with utm_campaign=stats_to_generator.
LuckyNumbersLab.guardrail: Keep entertainment-only and no-guarantee language visible
LuckyNumbersLab.stop_rule: Rewrite if CTR is below 1.5% after 500 sessions

LuckyNumbersLab.hypothesis: Users will pay when credits are framed around saved analysis and convenience, not better odds.
LuckyNumbersLab.action: At the free-credit limit, test: ‘Continue your analysis and save your number history.’ Show Starter $3.99 and Popular $9.99, clearly labeled one-time. Do not imply that payment improves winning probability.
LuckyNumbersLab.guardrail: No increase in gambling-responsibility complaints or misleading-claim feedback
LuckyNumbersLab.stop_rule: Revert if verified purchase conversion declines after 300 views

LuckyNumbersLab.hypothesis: A draw-specific saved-history reminder will increase return visits and eventually paid credit use.
LuckyNumbersLab.action: Offer an opt-in weekly draw-insights email after a user saves numbers. Include saved-history access, new draw statistics, responsible-gaming language, and one product CTA. Require explicit consent and one-click unsubscribe.
LuckyNumbersLab.target: Opt-in >= 8%; email return rate >= 10%; at least 1 verified purchase
LuckyNumbersLab.stop_rule: Pause if complaints exceed 0.1% or no return visits occur after 200 deliveries
